description: This file defines the 'team' class and related structures for managing game sides in the Wesnoth project, including team properties, shroud and fog management, and team info.

classes.name: team
classes.description: Represents a game side with properties like resources, units, shroud/fog, and AI settings.

classes.name: team::shroud_map
classes.description: Manages the visibility map (shroud) for a team.

classes.name: team::target
classes.description: Represents a target with criteria and value for a team.

classes.name: team::team_info
classes.description: Stores metadata about a team such as name, resources, AI parameters, and visual settings.

methods.name: team::write
methods.description: Serializes team data to a config object.

methods.name: team::get_village
methods.description: Checks if the team owns a specific village.

methods.name: team::lose_village
methods.description: Removes a village from the team.

methods.name: team::clear_villages
methods.description: Clears all villages owned by the team.

methods.name: team::owns_village
methods.description: Checks if the team owns a specific village.

methods.name: team::gold
methods.description: Returns the team's current gold.

methods.name: team::income
methods.description: Returns the team's income.

methods.name: team::new_turn
methods.description: Advances the team to a new turn.

methods.name: team::set_time_of_day
methods.description: Sets the time of day for the team.

methods.name: team::get_shared_maps
methods.description: Updates shared maps for the team.

methods.name: team::spend_gold
methods.description: Deducts gold from the team.

methods.name: team::set_income
methods.description: Sets the team's income.

methods.name: team::recruits
methods.description: Returns the set of recruitable units.

methods.name: team::recruits
methods.description: Returns the set of recruitable units (non-const version).

methods.name: team::recruitment_pattern
methods.description: Returns the recruitment pattern.

methods.name: team::name
methods.description: Returns the team's name.

methods.name: team::save_id
methods.description: Returns the team's save ID.

methods.name: team::set_objectives
methods.description: Sets the team's objectives.

methods.name: team::reset_objectives_changed
methods.description: Resets the objectives changed flag.

methods.name: team::objectives
methods.description: Returns the team's objectives.

methods.name: team::objectives_changed
methods.description: Checks if objectives have changed.

methods.name: team::is_enemy
methods.description: Checks if a given team index is an enemy.

methods.name: team::aggression
methods.description: Returns the team's aggression level.

methods.name: team::caution
methods.description: Returns the team's caution level.

methods.name: team::is_human
methods.description: Checks if the team is controlled by a human.

methods.name: team::is_network
methods.description: Checks if the team is controlled over a network.

methods.name: team::is_ai
methods.description: Checks if the team is AI-controlled.

methods.name: team::is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the team is empty.

methods.name: team::is_persistent
methods.description: Checks if the team is persistent.

methods.name: team::make_human
methods.description: Sets the team to be human-controlled.

methods.name: team::make_network
methods.description: Sets the team to be network-controlled.

methods.name: team::make_ai
methods.description: Sets the team to be AI-controlled.

methods.name: team::team_name
methods.description: Returns the team's name.

methods.name: team::change_team
methods.description: Changes the team's name.

methods.name: team::flag
methods.description: Returns the team's flag.

methods.name: team::ai_algorithm
methods.description: Returns the AI algorithm used.

methods.name: team::ai_parameters
methods.description: Returns the AI parameters.

methods.name: team::leader_value
methods.description: Returns the leader value.

methods.name: team::village_value
methods.description: Returns the village value.

methods.name: team::villages_per_scout
methods.description: Returns the number of villages per scout.

methods.name: team::targets
methods.description: Returns the team's targets.

methods.name: team::shrouded
methods.description: Checks if a hex is shrouded for this team.

methods.name: team::fogged
methods.description: Checks if a hex is fogged for this team.

methods.description: Checks if the team uses shroud.

methods.name: team::uses_fog
methods.description: Checks if the team uses fog.

methods.description: Clears shroud at a location.

methods.description: Checks if auto shroud updates are enabled.

methods.name: team::set_auto_shroud_updates
methods.description: Sets auto shroud updates.
